newsitem.title: USA: Ameriwood names Marlan Smith CFO.
newsitem.headline: Ameriwood names Marlan Smith CFO.

text.p: Ameriwood Industries International Corp said Monday it had named Marlan Smith chief financial officer.
Smith replaces Craig Wassenaar, whose resignation was announced last month.

The company said Smith was most recently principal financial and accounting officer at Kalamazoo, Mich.-based Great Dane Holdings Inc, a conglomerate whose operations include truck-trailer manufacturing, automotive stampings, taxicab leasing and insurance.
Ameriwood is a manufacturer of unassembled furniture for the home and office.
